product.title: Whale Watching Tour From Monterey

description.text: Cruise Monterey Bay on a guided whale-watching trip from Old Fisherman's Wharf with a naturalist crew. The route searches for gray, humpback, and blue whales plus dolphins, sea lions, and seabirds in the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary.

highlights: Guided whale-watching cruise from Monterey Bay
Search for gray, humpback, and blue whales
Views of dolphins, sea lions, and seabirds

start.description: Board at Old Fisherman's Wharf in Monterey at the operator location listed in your confirmation.

end.description: Return to Old Fisherman's Wharf after the bay cruise.
